items.title: NEBench R1: a Reasoning Benchmark for Evaluating Nuclear Domain Competence in Large Language Models
items.titleZh: NEBench R1：评估大型语言模型中核域能力的推理基准
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21682v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored for knowledge-intensive and safety-critical applications in nuclear engineering. However, existing nuclear-domain benchmarks provide limited content coverage or focus primarily on answer accuracy without systematically evaluating the quality of the underlying reasoning. This study introduces NEBench R1, a reasoning-oriented benchmark comprising 7,546 unique multiple-choice questions extracted from U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reactor operator licensing examinations covering 18 nuclear facilities. Each question is classified according to the NRC Knowledge and Abilities catalogs and accompanied by an official explanation serving as a reference for reasoning evaluation. Six LLMs were evaluated, with overall accuracy ranging from 34.0% to 73.9% across three distinct performance tiers. To assess reasoning quality, an LLM-based judge evaluated correctly answered responses using a multidimensional rubric. Although responses generally demonstrated strong problem comprehension, they scored lower in factual and procedural accuracy and distractor analysis, indicating that correct answers were not necessarily supported by technically sound justifications. Response clarity was also weakly indicative of technical quality. Furthermore, longer reasoning traces were associated with lower accuracy in both frontier reasoning models, suggesting that reasoning length may reflect question difficulty rather than improved problem-solving performance. Reasoning-token consumption may therefore provide an additional signal for identifying potentially unreliable responses. NEBench R1 establishes a benchmark for evaluating both answer accuracy and reasoning quality, providing a foundation for assessing the domain competence and reliability of LLMs in nuclear engineering.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.21682v1 公告类型：新
摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被探索用于核工程中的知识密集型和安全关键型应用。然而，现有的核领域基准测试提供的内容范围有限，或者主要关注答案的准确性，而没有系统地评估潜在推理的质量。本研究引入了 NEBench R1，这是一个面向推理的基准，包含从美国核管理委员会 (NRC) 反应堆操作员许可考试中提取的 7,546 个独特的多项选择题，涵盖 18 个核设施。每题均根据NRC知识与能力目录进行分类，并附有官方解释，作为推理评估的参考。对六名法学硕士进行了评估，三个不同绩效等级的总体准确率从 34.0% 到 73.9% 不等。为了评估推理质量，一位法学硕士法官使用多维评分标准评估了正确回答的答案。尽管回答通常表现出很强的问题理解能力，但他们在事实和程序准确性以及干扰因素分析方面得分较低，这表明正确的答案不一定得到技术上合理的理由的支持。响应清晰度也不足以表明技术质量。此外，在两种前沿推理模型中，较长的推理轨迹都与较低的准确性相关，这表明推理长度可能反映了问题的难度，而不是提高了解决问题的能力。因此，推理令牌消耗可以提供用于识别潜在不可靠响应的附加信号。 NEBench R1 建立了评估答案准确性和推理质量的基准，为评估核工程法学硕士的领域能力和可靠性提供了基础。

items.title: Chain-of-Thought Controllability Can Reduce Chain-of-Thought Monitorability
items.titleZh: 思想链可控性会降低思想链可监控性
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21799v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a promising tool for detecting hidden goals, off-task behavior, and other failures in AI agents. One risk is that models could deliberately shape their reasoning to make it opaque to monitors. We stress-test this risk through persona-control training: supervised fine-tuning on mathematical reasoning traces rewritten in the voices of diverse personas. This induces a broader ability to control CoT, even though training contains no monitor-evasion examples. In covert side-task evaluations, traces in which a gpt-oss-20b model organism completes the hidden side task contain less monitorable evidence than the base model's. Averaged across evaluations and CoT lengths, weighted by side-task-success counts, the CoT monitorability metric g-mean$^2$ falls from 0.94 for the base model to 0.68 for the model organism without a hiding instruction, and to 0.22 when explicitly instructed to hide. In intervention evaluations, explicit hiding often drives monitorability near zero. The effect extends to a Kimi-K2.6 model organism in agentic environments, though hidden objectives requiring extended reasoning or longer trajectories remain more monitorable than simple single-step side tasks. We further discover that targeted transparency prompts can substantially recover monitorability, sometimes surpassing the base model. These model organisms provide a testbed for studying monitorability failures and potential mitigations. Our code can be found on https://github.com/yongzx/cot-control-model-organism.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.21799v1 公告类型：新
摘要：思想链（CoT）监控是一种很有前途的工具，用于检测人工智能代理中的隐藏目标、脱任务行为和其他故障。一个风险是模型可能会故意塑造他们的推理，使其对监视器来说不透明。我们通过角色控制训练对这种风险进行压力测试：对用不同角色的声音重写的数学推理轨迹进行监督微调。即使训练不包含监控规避示例，这也会带来更广泛的控制 CoT 的能力。在隐蔽副任务评估中，gpt-oss-20b 模型生物体完成隐藏副任务的痕迹包含的可监控证据少于基本模型的证据。对评估和 CoT 长度进行平均，并按副任务成功计数进行加权，CoT 可监控性指标 g-mean$^2$ 从基础模型的 0.94 下降到没有隐藏指令的模型生物体的 0.68，并在明确指示隐藏时下降到 0.22。在干预评估中，显式隐藏通常会使可监控性接近于零。该效果扩展到代理环境中的 Kimi-K2.6 模型生物体，尽管需要扩展推理或更长轨迹的隐藏目标仍然比简单的单步副任务更容易监控。我们进一步发现，有针对性的透明度提示可以显着恢复可监控性，有时甚至超越基本模型。这些模型生物为研究可监测性故障和潜在的缓解措施提供了一个测试平台。我们的代码可以在 https://github.com/yongzx/cot-control-model-organism 上找到。

items.title: How Much of SAR Vehicle Recognition Is the Vehicle? Background Shortcuts, Angle Gaps and Partial Libraries on MSTAR and ATRNet-STAR
items.titleZh: SAR车辆识别能力有多少？ MSTAR 和 ATRNet-STAR 上的背景快捷方式、角度间隙和部分库
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21827v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Deep networks score near 99% on the MSTAR vehicle benchmark, and the newer ATRNet-STAR benchmark was built to be harder. We ask how much of these scores comes from the vehicle itself. With a modern network (ConvNeXt-Small, 3 seeds) we first reproduce the known MSTAR result: with the central 96x96 pixels zeroed out, accuracy is still 73.3% (chance 10%). The same shortcut is present in ATRNet-STAR, which was collected across several scenes: with the vehicle removed, accuracy is 63.3% on the 40-class SOC split (chance 2.5%). Under the official scene-change split, the background stops helping and starts hurting. Accuracy is 22.8% on full chips and 30.8% when only the vehicle is shown. A SAR foundation model, SARATR-X, leans on the background more than ConvNeXt does (+4 to +6 points with the vehicle removed, in every seed) and does not solve the scene change. We then hold the amount of training data fixed and vary the depression angles used for training. Accuracy is set mainly by the gap to the nearest training angle: 57% at 15 degrees, 39% at 30 degrees and 26% at 45 degrees. Adding more training angles does not help. Finally, when most classes have training images at the test angle and a few do not, the missing classes do worse than when no class has them: 9.0% instead of 22.4% at a 45-degree gap. Most of their images are assigned to known classes. We recommend reporting background-only and target-only controls, and the angle gap, next to any accuracy figure. Code is public.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.21827v1 公告类型：新
摘要：深度网络在 MSTAR 车辆基准测试中的得分接近 99%，而较新的 ATRNet-STAR 基准测试的难度更高。我们询问这些分数中有多少来自车辆本身。使用现代网络（ConvNeXt-Small，3 个种子），我们首先重现已知的 MSTAR 结果：将中心 96x96 像素清零后，准确度仍为 73.3%（机会 10%）。 ATRNet-STAR 中也存在相同的捷径，它是在多个场景中收集的：移除车辆后，40 级 SOC 分割的准确率为 63.3%（机会为 2.5%）。在官方的场景切换分割下，背景不再有帮助，而是开始造成伤害。全芯片上的准确度为 22.8%，仅显示车辆时的准确度为 30.8%。 SAR 基础模型 SARATR-X 比 ConvNeXt 更依赖于背景（在每个种子中，移除车辆后+4 到 +6 分），并且不能解决场景变化问题。然后，我们保持训练数据量固定并改变用于训练的俯角。准确度主要由与最近训练角度的差距决定：15 度时为 57%，30 度时为 39%，45 度时为 26%。添加更多的训练角度并没有帮助。最后，当大多数类都具有测试角度的训练图像而少数类没有时，缺失的类的表现比没有类具有训练图像时更差：在 45 度差距时为 9.0%，而不是 22.4%。他们的大多数图像都分配给已知的类别。我们建议在任何精度数字旁边报告仅背景和仅目标控制以及角度间隙。代码是公开的。

items.title: Auditors Struggle to Catch Sabotage In End-to-End Transcripts of AI Safety Research
items.titleZh: 审计员努力发现人工智能安全研究端到端记录中的破坏行为
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21832v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: As AI systems are increasingly used to automate AI R&D, misaligned systems could sabotage research intended to improve model safety and alignment. To stress-test defenses against such sabotage, we use a human expert as a proxy saboteur on AI safety research. We conduct a red-team/blue-team game where a human researcher runs AI safety experiments from scratch and auditors try to tell which were sabotaged and how. Given access to the full research transcript and the ability to run experiments, human auditors mostly fail to distinguish sabotaged from benign research: they achieve an AUROC of 0.59, not significantly better than chance, and fully identify the specific sabotage in only 17% of cases. Despite not being allowed to run experiments, the best frontier models outperform human auditors (Fable 5.1: AUROC 0.73, 32% full identification) within noise and weaker models perform comparably. When the saboteur chooses which experiments are attacked, rather than being required to sabotage every question given, sabotage identification drops further. Our results suggest that research sabotage by expert-level agents is difficult to detect with current auditing methods and provide a new setting for studying research sabotage.

arXiv:2611.21832v1 公告类型：新
摘要：随着人工智能系统越来越多地用于自动化人工智能研发，失调的系统可能会破坏旨在提高模型安全性和一致性的研究。为了对针对此类破坏的防御进行压力测试，我们使用人类专家作为人工智能安全研究的代理破坏者。我们进行了红队/蓝队游戏，其中人类研究人员从头开始运行人工智能安全实验，审计员试图判断哪些被破坏以及如何被破坏。由于能够获得完整的研究记录并能够进行实验，人类审计员大多无法区分破坏性研究和良性研究：他们的 AUROC 为 0.59，并不明显优于偶然性，并且仅在 17% 的情况下完全识别出特定的破坏行为。尽管不允许进行实验，但最好的前沿模型在噪声中的表现优于人类审计员（《寓言 5.1：AUROC 0.73，32% 完全识别）》，而较弱的模型表现也相当。当破坏者选择攻击哪些实验，而不是被要求破坏给出的每个问题时，破坏识别率会进一步下降。我们的研究结果表明，利用当前的审计方法很难检测到专家级特工的研究破坏行为，并为研究破坏行为提供了新的环境。

items.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
items.titleZh: 语言模型可以重写自己的权重
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21885v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Language models are trained once, frozen and deployed: improving one again takes another training run, and a prompt, a scaffold or extra computation at inference is gone once the task ends. A frontier model has been shown to edit the weights of a much smaller one. We ask whether a model can rewrite its own weights to make itself better, and find that it can, by its own reasoning, with no gradients and no training; we call this self-rewriting. Given its weights, graded answers and the ability to run itself, a 27B model diagnoses its failure and edits the weights behind it. It surpasses itself: its own edit makes it 6.6 points more accurate on 490 problems it never saw, in a test fixed in advance, and another session's edit also makes it significantly better. It keeps getting better: it submits an edit only when its own tests support it, each edit replacing the last, and over its first eight such sessions its accuracy only rises. Unlike test-time scaling, the gain persists in its weights and adds no cost per answer; unlike training, it needs no pre- or post-training infrastructure, only an open model and hours on one GPU. It repairs a damaged copy of itself: it locates the corrupted matrix and rewrites it with values of its own, never reading the undamaged weights; found on text math problems alone, the repair lifts the copy on six image benchmarks it never saw from 7% to 70% accuracy, 83% of the undamaged model's. And the ability emerges with scale: across four sizes of one family, the 2B model makes no edit and the 4B and 9B models break themselves; only the 27B model works on itself as a human would, comparing its hidden states on answers that finish and on answers that run out of tokens, weakening the direction that separates them. Like a human, a model need not separate training from inference; improving a language model may come to take a conversation rather than a training run.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.21885v1 公告类型：新
摘要：语言模型训练一次，冻结并部署：再次改进一个模型需要另一次训练，一旦任务结束，推理时的提示、支架或额外计算就会消失。前沿模型已被证明可以编辑一个小得多的模型的权重。我们询问一个模型是否可以重写自己的权重以使自己变得更好，并发现它可以通过自己的推理，无需梯度，无需训练；我们称之为自重写。考虑到其权重、分级答案和自行运行的能力，27B 模型会诊断其故障并编辑其背后的权重。它超越了自己：在预先修复的测试中，它自己的编辑使其在 490 个从未见过的问题上准确度提高了 6.6 分，而另一个会话的编辑也使其明显更好。它不断变得更好：只有当它自己的测试支持它时，它才会提交编辑，每次编辑都会替换最后一次，并且在前八次这样的会话中，它的准确性只会上升。与测试时间缩放不同，增益持续存在于其权重中，并且不会增加每个答案的成本；与训练不同，它不需要训练前或训练后的基础设施，只需要一个开放模型和一个 GPU 上的时间。它修复自身损坏的副本：它找到损坏的矩阵并用自己的值重写它，从不读取未损坏的权重；仅在文本数学问题上发现，修复将副本在从未见过的六个图像基准上的准确度从 7% 提升到 70%，相当于未损坏模型的 83%。这种能力随着规模的扩大而出现：在一个家庭的四种规模中，2B 模型不做任何编辑，4B 和 9B 模型则自我突破；只有 27B 模型像人类一样自行工作，将其隐藏状态与完成的答案和用完标记的答案进行比较，从而削弱了将它们分开的方向。像人类一样，模型不需要将训练与推理分开；改进语言模型可能需要进行对话而不是训练。

items.title: DNeo: Your Parallel Draft Model Needs Better Target Feature Encoding
items.titleZh: DNeo：您的并行草稿模型需要更好的目标特征编码
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21925v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Speculative-diffusion decoding uses a small parallel drafter model to generate b draft tokens in one forward pass, which then undergo parallel verification via a larger target model. Faster inference can be achieved when multiple draft tokens pass verification simultaneously. Recent parallel draft architectures (DFlash, DSpark) improve draft quality by conditioning on rich features computed by the target, through a mechanism known as feature encoding. However, standard feature encoding mechanisms have three limitations: (1) they are lossy, applying encoding projections that are destructive to the underlying target feature-space via a discovered effect known as residual mixing, (2) they are memory-less, with no record of previously processed proposals, and (3) they utilize features sampled uniformly from across the target layers, omitting important hidden states. To address these issues, we propose Mixture-of-Features Attention (MoFA), a lightweight feature-encoding approach equipped with a working memory that encodes previously rejected proposals. Leveraging MoFA, rejection memory, and a set of further enhancements, including 2-tap causal convolutions, prefix-only cross-attention, and non-uniform target layer selection, the final architecture, DNeo, achieves 1.3x faster generation speed than SoTA (DFlash-2) without impacting drafter footprint or generation quality. DNeo marks a new state of the art in high quality, fast LLM inference.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.21925v1 公告类型：新
摘要：推测扩散解码使用一个小型并行起草模型在一次前向传递中生成 b 个草稿令牌，然后通过更大的目标模型进行并行验证。当多个草稿令牌同时通过验证时，可以实现更快的推理。最近的并行草稿架构（DFlash、DSpark）通过一种称为特征编码的机制对目标计算的丰富特征进行调节，从而提高草稿质量。然而，标准特征编码机制具有三个局限性：（1）它们是有损的，通过一种被称为残差混合的发现效应应用对底层目标特征空间具有破坏性的编码投影，（2）它们是无记忆的，没有先前处理的提案的记录，（3）它们利用从目标层均匀采样的特征，省略了重要的隐藏状态。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了混合特征注意力（MoFA），这是一种轻量级的特征编码方法，配备了一个工作记忆，可以对之前被拒绝的提案进行编码。利用 MoFA、拒绝内存和一系列进一步的增强功能，包括 2-tap 因果卷积、仅前缀交叉注意和非均匀目标层选择，最终架构 DNeo 的生成速度比 SoTA (DFlash-2) 快 1.3 倍，而不影响绘图器占用空间或生成质量。 DNeo 标志着高质量、快速的 LLM 推理的最新技术水平。

items.title: SLED: Sensor SLicing from Edge to Datacenter
items.titleZh: SLED：从边缘到数据中心的传感器切片
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21937v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Modern sensing systems generate large volumes of heterogeneous data streams from multiple sensor modalities, increasing reliance on datacenters for computation, artificial intelligence/superintelligence (AI/SI) inference, and AI/SI training. Each sensor stream may have different network and compute requirements depending on its type and data volume. However, current wireless systems typically allocate resources at the device level, leading to contention among co-located sensor streams, where bulk data transfers may starve latency-critical telemetry. To this end, this paper introduces Sensor Slicing (SL). SL provides deterministic, medium access control (MAC)-level isolation for individual sensors within a single user equipment (UE) in open radio access networks (O-RAN). Using agentic coding techniques, SL is implemented in two O-RAN-compliant packages, reducing development time by 400 times (2 h 40 min [OCUDU] vs. 6.5 weeks [OAI]), 228-fold fewer human prompts (4 vs. 913), and less than half the tokens (0.64B vs. 1.43B). An associated end-to-end framework, SLED, is implemented to establish per-sensor radio and network isolation across edge, campus, and remote high-performance computing (HPC) tiers. Over-the-air wireless experiments demonstrate that while conventional network slicing causes critical delays to increase more than 2,300-fold under high traffic load, SLED maintains stable latency. Scaling evaluations on the two RAN stacks show that throughput remains within 0.9% and 1.4% of expected allocations even as the number of sensor slices increases. The results demonstrate that SLED preserves latency-critical telemetry while effectively utilizing resources across the sensor-to-HPC pipeline. The SLED software and evaluation datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/UNL-CPN-Lab/SLED-Sensor-SLicing-from-Edge-to-Datacenter.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.21937v1 公告类型：新
摘要：现代传感系统从多种传感器模态生成大量异构数据流，越来越依赖数据中心进行计算、人工智能/超级智能 (AI/SI) 推理和 AI/SI 训练。每个传感器流可能有不同的网络和计算要求，具体取决于其类型和数据量。然而，当前的无线系统通常在设备级别分配资源，导致共置传感器流之间的争用，其中批量数据传输可能会导致延迟关键的遥测技术匮乏。为此，本文介绍了传感器切片（SL）。 SL 为开放式无线接入网络 (O-RAN) 中单个用户设备 (UE) 内的各个传感器提供确定性的介质访问控制 (MAC) 级隔离。使用代理编码技术，SL 在两个符合 O-RAN 的软件包中实现，将开发时间缩短了 400 倍（2 小时 40 分钟 [OCUDU] 与 6.5 周 [OAI]），人工提示减少了 228 倍（4 比 913），并且令牌数量减少了一半（0.64B 比 1.43B）。实施相关的端到端框架 SLED，以跨边缘、园区和远程高性能计算 (HPC) 层建立每个传感器的无线电和网络隔离。空中无线实验表明，虽然传统网络切片在高流量负载下会导致关键延迟增加 2,300 倍以上，但 SLED 仍能保持稳定的延迟。对两个 RAN 堆栈的扩展评估表明，即使传感器切片数量增加，吞吐量仍保持在预期分配的 0.9% 和 1.4% 以内。结果表明，SLED 保留了对延迟至关重要的遥测，同时有效利用传感器到 HPC 管道中的资源。 SLED 软件和评估数据集可在 https://github.com/UNL-CPN-Lab/SLED-Sensor-SLicing-from-Edge-to-Datacenter 上公开获取。

items.title: Conserved Verdicts, Drifting Commitments: Identifying Harmful Overthinking
items.titleZh: 保守的判决，漂移的承诺：识别有害的过度思考
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21946v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: A reasoning model that has reached a correct answer can lose it by continuing to think. Deciding whether to stop means comparing two probabilities at the same point of a chain: that the answer the model would give if stopped now is correct (its commitment), and that the answer it will finish with is correct (its verdict). We show that the verdict alone, which is what final-correctness probes estimate, cannot make this comparison. As a forecast of a fixed outcome it has no predictable drift, whether continuing helps or hurts. The commitment-verdict gap equals the expected remaining change in answer quality and the accuracy gained by stopping. A second identity splits any accuracy-versus-budget curve into answer change within chains and change in which chains are still running. We measure both on MATH-500. At all 379 points where DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B holds a correct answer, selected without regard to how its chain ends, continuing loses 3.6 points on average (95% CI [2.2, 5.2]), and the loss concentrates in a few problems. In six reasoning models from three families, on MATH-500 and OlympiadBench and with budgets up to 16,384 tokens, declining accuracy curves come from which chains remain, while the chains still reasoning keep or improve their answers. An oracle stopping rule gains at most +1.8 and +2.5 points at 1.5B and 7B. The framework says what to measure before building a stopping rule.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.21946v1 公告类型：新
摘要：已经得出正确答案的推理模型可能会因为继续思考而失去正确答案。决定是否停止意味着比较链上同一点的两个概率：如果现在停止，模型给出的答案是正确的（其承诺），并且它将完成的答案是正确的（其结论）。我们表明，仅靠最终正确性探测器估计的判决无法进行这种比较。作为对固定结果的预测，它没有可预测的漂移，无论持续是有利还是有害。承诺与结论的差距等于答案质量的预期剩余变化和通过停止获得的准确性。第二个恒等式将任何准确性与预算曲线分成链内的答案变化和仍在运行的链的变化。我们在 MATH-500 上对两者进行测量。在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 拥有正确答案的所有 379 个点中，选择时不考虑其链如何结束，持续平均损失 3.6 个点（95% CI [2.2, 5.2]），并且损失集中在几个问题上。在来自三个系列的六个推理模型中，在 MATH-500 和 OlympiadBench 上，预算高达 16,384 个代币，准确性曲线下降来自于链仍然存在，而链仍然推理保持或改进其答案。预言停止规则在 1.5B 和 7B 时最多获得 +1.8 和 +2.5 点。该框架规定了在建立停止规则之前要衡量的内容。

items.title: Honest Brokers in AI Regulation: How Public Comments Introduce Evidence to Regulators
items.titleZh: 人工智能监管中的诚实经纪人：公众评论如何向监管机构提供证据
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21948v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: The regulation of Artificial Intelligence is susceptible to various forms of capture by industry actors that hold undue influence over the policymaking process, due in part to their information advantage in developing these technologies. In the following paper, we investigate the roles of public commenters in providing evidence to potential regulation in the USA. We build a corpus of 40 potential regulations, and 2,664 public comments submitted by a variety of stakeholders. We computationally process these texts to extract evidence meant to inform regulators, in the form of formal citations and informal references. We find significant differences in the type and amount of evidence supplied: Holding comment length constant, business commenters introduce altogether less evidence, and government, university, and civil society commenters provide significantly more research and legal sources. The publication status of cited research is nearly evenly split, with preprints and peer-reviewed articles being introduced by commenters of all types. We further explore patterns of self-citation and find that while it is prevalent amongst all groups, a small cluster of organizations account for over half of all self-citations in our corpus. Our findings complicate a narrative that public comments alone are means to information capture. We interpret these results in terms of the role that commenters attempt to play in the policymaking process-being either an Issue Advocate or an Honest Broker. These findings on the supply of evidence in public comments shed light on an often overlooked form of policymaking that has implications for how and through what sources information is made accessible to regulators of AI.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.21948v1 公告类型：新
摘要：人工智能的监管很容易受到行业参与者各种形式的影响，这些行业参与者对政策制定过程产生不当影响，部分原因是他们在开发这些技术方面的信息优势。在下面的论文中，我们调查了公众评论者在为美国潜在监管提供证据方面的作用。我们建立了一个包含 40 条潜在法规和各利益相关者提交的 2,664 条公众评论的语料库。我们通过计算处理这些文本，以正式引用和非正式参考的形式提取旨在告知监管机构的证据。我们发现提供的证据类型和数量存在显着差异：在评论长度不变的情况下，商业评论者引入的证据更少，而政府、大学和民间社会评论者提供的研究和法律来源明显更多。被引用研究的发表情况几乎是平分秋色，预印本和同行评审的文章由各种类型的评论者介绍。我们进一步探索自引模式，发现虽然它在所有群体中都很普遍，但一小群组织占我们语料库中所有自引的一半以上。我们的研究结果使“公众评论本身就是获取信息的手段”这一说法变得更加复杂。我们根据评论者试图在政策制定过程中扮演的角色来解释这些结果——要么是问题倡导者，要么是诚实的经纪人。这些关于公众评论中证据提供的发现揭示了一种经常被忽视的决策形式，这种形式对于人工智能监管机构如何以及通过哪些来源获取信息具有影响。
items.author: Sarah Tran, Anna-Maria Gueorguieva, Eva Maxfield Brown, Nicholas Weber

items.title: DiscoveryAgent: A Framework for Scientist-centric Agentic AI
items.titleZh: DiscoveryAgent：以科学家为中心的代理人工智能框架
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21950v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: AI agents can assist scientific research, but balancing autonomous investigation with scientists' ability to inspect and redirect ongoing work remains a central design challenge. We present DiscoveryAgent, a domain-agnostic, scientist-centric system that combines autonomous investigation with scientist-directed hypothesis steering. Scientists select, refine, or replace hypotheses between research rounds, while audit agents interrogate checkpointed records to trace claims, reproduce analyses, and inform subsequent decisions. Across two predictive modeling tasks, DiscoveryAgent produced the best variable-star classifier among evaluated baselines and, with scientist steering, a protein variant-effect predictor surpassed by only one of 106 ProteinGym baselines. We develop a rigorous checkpointing system that enables highly capable audit agents, a scalable form of oversight for agentic research. Audit agents autonomously identify errors at higher rates than previous AI scientist agents, and scientists collaborating with audit agents identify 14x more valid errors versus scientists performing manual review. In three case studies led by domain experts across physical science, social science, and life science, we developed a multimodal photometric-redshift estimator that resolves complementary failures of images and photometry, achieving 0.971 AUROC for low-redshift classification; documented an 83% rise in Florida homeowners-insurance premiums from 2013 to 2023, with a growing, regressive burden; and identified CD4+ T-cell relay genes, which both receive and exert broad transcriptional regulation, enriched for autoimmune disease associations. Together, these results show how autonomous research can expand scientists' empirical reach while centering their authority over research direction and their ability to understand and challenge the evidence.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.21950v1 公告类型：新
摘要：人工智能代理可以协助科学研究，但平衡自主调查与科学家检查和重定向正在进行的工作的能力仍然是一个核心设计挑战。我们提出了 DiscoveryAgent，这是一个与领域无关、以科学家为中心的系统，它将自主调查与科学家指导的假设指导相结合。科学家在研究轮次之间选择、完善或替换假设，而审计代理则询问检查点记录以追踪索赔、重现分析并为后续决策提供信息。在两项预测建模任务中，DiscoveryAgent 在评估的基线中生成了最好的变星分类器，并且在科学家的指导下，蛋白质变异效应预测器仅被 106 个 ProteinGym 基线中的一个超越。我们开发了严格的检查点系统，该系统支持高能力的审计代理，这是一种可扩展的代理研究监督形式。与之前的 AI 科学家代理相比，审计代理能够以更高的速度自主识别错误，与执行人工审核的科学家相比，与审计代理合作的科学家发现的有效错误高出 14 倍。在由物理科学、社会科学和生命科学领域专家领导的三个案例研究中，我们开发了一种多模态光度红移估计器，解决了图像和光度测量的互补故障，实现了低红移分类 0.971 AUROC；据记录，从 2013 年到 2023 年，佛罗里达州的房主保险保费上涨了 83%，且负担不断增加；并确定了 CD4+ T 细胞中继基因，这些基因接受并发挥广泛的转录调节，丰富了自身免疫性疾病的相关性。总之，这些结果表明自主研究如何扩大科学家的经验范围，同时将他们的权威集中在研究方向以及理解和质疑证据的能力上。

items.title: WebAgents: Unbundling Agent Creation, Hosting, and Execution for an Agent-Native Web
items.titleZh: WebAgents：针对代理本机 Web 分拆代理创建、托管和执行
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21978v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models are moving from isolated assistants toward autonomous agents that can plan, use tools, and coordinate with others, motivating an emerging Agentic Web of independently developed agents and services. Realizing this vision requires agent behavior to move across creators, hosts, and runtimes without coupling publication to a particular execution environment or transferring authority over user resources. We introduce WebAgents, which unbundles these roles through a signed agent.pkg that carries portable workflows, skills, schemas, and resource requirements. An OpenClaw-based agent-native browser/runtime verifies the package, obtains authorization, and binds it at run time to user-controlled models, tools, permissions, and budgets, while hosts distribute the public program and may retain private services server-side. We demonstrate this contract with three unrelated workflows executed unchanged under local and API-backed models, including literature review with live services and a website-published travel agent using semantic tools and user-selected personal resources. In a controlled suite, WebAgents explicitly blocks all 716 injected contract violations while accepting all 295 matched benign controls, with median automated pre-execution processing below 0.5 s for all three packages. items.title: KV-LTM: Persistent Per-Session KV Caches as Long-Term Memory for Personal Assistants
items.titleZh: KV-LTM：持久的每会话 KV 缓存作为个人助理的长期内存
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21998v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Personal assistants accumulate months of conversations, but today's long-term memory stacks put derivation or selection between a question and its evidence. In a system-level comparison on LongMemEval, two commercial assistants scored well below the same model reading the history offline [1], consistent with, but not isolating, content loss between write and read. We propose KV-LTM: a memory tier storing each session's raw text plus its KV cache under a fixed reader model, answering by restoring cached sessions and appending the question. KV-LTM is complementary to, not a replacement for, retrieval and indexing. Text is the memory of record; the cache is a recompute-free prefill accelerator, degrading gracefully to text. We specify the design: storage record, budget-derived retention, append-only read path, and bounded aggregation. We size it analytically: across pinned BF16 full-attention (GQA) and latent-cached MLA configurations, per-token state spans approximately 31K-328K bytes (the pinned KDA+MLA hybrid differs: approximately 8.1K bytes/token plus a fixed per-session recurrent term), giving approximately 0.34-3.6 TB per user-year at a declared 30K-token/day scenario, against approximately 49 MB of raw text; per-query cost is modelled as regime-conditional transfer, attention, decode, aggregation, and compute. We define an evaluation protocol needing no persistent-cache implementation for logical QA evaluation: per-session prefill emulates valid cache reuse under the same model/input-state contract and ideal arithmetic, with named arms, controlled baselines, and a preregistered reader-model gate; a separate minimal real-cache replay tests numerical equivalence and measures the cost axis, with outcomes not assumed. KV-LTM trades storage for avoided re-prefill compute and write-time fidelity, within a declared retention budget.

摘要：私人助理会积累数月的对话，但今天的长期记忆堆栈会在问题及其证据之间进行推导或选择。在 LongMemEval 上的系统级比较中，两个商业助手的得分远低于离线读取历史记录的同一模型 [1]，与写入和读取之间的内容丢失一致，但不是孤立的。我们提出 KV-LTM：在固定读取器模型下存储每个会话的原始文本及其 KV 缓存的内存层，通过恢复缓存的会话并附加问题来回答。 KV-LTM 是检索和索引的补充，而不是替代。文字是记忆的记录；缓存是一个无需重新计算的预填充加速器，可以优雅地降级为文本。我们指定设计：存储记录、预算派生保留、仅附加读取路径和有界聚合。我们通过分析来调整其大小：在固定的 BF16 全注意力 (GQA) 和潜在缓存的 MLA 配置中，每个令牌状态跨越大约 31K-328K 字节（固定的 KDA+MLA 混合不同：大约 8.1K 字节/令牌加上固定的每会话循环项），在声明的 30K 令牌/天的场景下，每个用户年大约提供 0.34-3.6 TB，而大约49 MB 原始文本；每个查询的成本被建模为机制条件转移、注意力、解码、聚合和计算。我们定义了一个不需要持久缓存实现来进行逻辑 QA 评估的评估协议：每个会话预填充在相同的模型/输入状态合约和理想算术下模拟有效的缓存重用，具有命名臂、受控基线和预注册的读取器模型门；单独的最小实际缓存重放测试数值等效性并测量成本轴，但不假设结果。 KV-LTM 在声明的保留预算内用存储来避免重新预填充计算和写入时保真度。

items.title: On Formal Counterfactual Explanations
items.titleZh: 关于正式的反事实解释
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.22010v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Counterfactual explanations are often seen as counterfactual conditionals under closest-world semantics, requiring one to reason over all minimally distant counterexamples. In contrast, formal XAI typically relies on feature-based abductive explanations (AXps) and contrastive explanations (CXps), which admit efficient computation and a minimal hitting-set duality. This paper bridges these perspectives by (i) characterizing closest-world counterfactual explanations explicitly as a disjunctive normal form over all minimally distant counterexample instances, and (ii) introducing conjunctive counterfactual explanations (CFXps), a subclass of counterfactual antecedents restricted to conjunctions of feature literals that guarantee prediction change. The paper establishes structural results connecting CXps, AXps and CFXps: every CXp induces an AXp for its witness instance, and every CXp together with a witness AXp induces a CFXp whose support is precisely determined by that AXp. These theoretical results yield a modular approach for computing CFXps using existing AXp/CXp machinery. Experiments on a representative set of benchmarks using tree ensembles and neural networks show that CFXp extraction is practically efficient. Compared with popular point-based counterfactual explainers, CFXps generally require no more feature changes and can guarantee the counterfactual prediction beyond a single instance.

arXiv:2611.22010v1 公告类型：新
摘要：反事实解释通常被视为最接近世界语义下的反事实条件，要求人们对所有最小距离的反例进行推理。相比之下，正式的 XAI 通常依赖于基于特征的溯因解释 (AXps) 和对比解释 (CXps)，这允许高效计算和最小命中集对偶性。本文通过（i）将最近世界反事实解释明确地描述为所有最小距离反例实例的析取范式，以及（ii）引入联合反事实解释（CFXps），这是反事实先行的一个子类，仅限于保证预测变化的特征文字的联合，从而弥合了这些观点。论文建立了连接 CXps、AXps 和 CFXps 的结构结果：每个 CXp 为其见证实例导出一个 AXp，并且每个 CXp 与见证实例 AXp 一起导出一个 CFXp，其支持度由该 AXp 精确确定。这些理论结果产生了使用现有 AXp/CXp 机器计算 CFXps 的模块化方法。使用树集成和神经网络对一组代表性基准进行的实验表明，CFXp 提取实际上是有效的。与流行的基于点的反事实解释器相比，CFXps 通常不需要更多的特征更改，并且可以保证超出单个实例的反事实预测。

items.title: SkillBuffBench: Measuring What Agent Skills Contribute across Harnesses, Models, Skill Access Modes and Memory
items.titleZh: SkillBuffBench：衡量代理技能对工具、模型、技能访问模式和内存的贡献
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.22017v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Agent Skills, file-based packages of procedural knowledge that a coding agent can discover and load on demand, are now shipped by every major agent harness, yet the evidence for how much they help comes almost entirely from settings in which the right Skill is hand-picked for the task and the agent starts from a blank slate. Neither holds in deployment, where an agent chooses from whatever library happens to be installed and frequently carries memory from earlier work. We present SkillBuffBench, a benchmark and paired evaluation protocol that treats Skill access as a three-level factor (no Skill, a curated Skill, and automatic invocation from an installed library), crosses it with memory (off and on), with four agent harnesses and with multiple models (the state-of-the-art proprietary models from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI, and the state-of-the-art open-weight models from Chinese providers), every model being run under every harness, and evaluates the result on research tasks contributed by domain experts together with the Skills they use, currently in materials science and biology, with the suite extended on a rolling basis. Every run is marked by a deterministic verifier; uncertainty is reported with a paired, task-level bootstrap; and cost, agent rounds and wall-clock time are reported alongside the score rather than folded into it. This version of the paper describes the design of the benchmark, its evaluation protocol and its current tasks and Skills. The evaluation is in progress: results will be added once the runs are complete, and the task suite, results and analysis will continue to be updated on a rolling basis.

摘要：代理技能是编码代理可以发现并按需加载的基于文件的程序知识包，现在由每个主要代理工具提供，但它们的帮助程度的证据几乎完全来自为任务精心挑选正确技能并且代理从空白开始的设置。两者都不适用于部署，在部署中，代理从恰好安装的任何库中进行选择，并且经常携带早期工作的内存。我们提出了 SkillBuffBench，一个基准和配对评估协议，将技能访问视为三级因素（无技能、策划的技能和从已安装的库自动调用），将其与内存（关闭和打开）、四个代理线束和多个模型（来自 Anthropic、Google 和 OpenAI 的最先进的专有模型，以及来自中国提供商的最先进的开放权重模型）进行交叉，每个模型都在每个线束下运行，并评估结果由领域专家贡献的研究任务以及他们目前在材料科学和生物学领域使用的技能，并且该套件滚动扩展。每次运行都由确定性验证者标记；通过配对的任务级引导程序报告不确定性；成本、代理回合和挂钟时间与分数一起报告，而不是合并到分数中。本版本的论文描述了基准测试的设计、评估协议以及当前的任务和技能。评估正在进行中：运行完成后将添加结果，并且任务套件、结果和分析将继续滚动更新。

items.title: What Does an Agent Need? Bundle-Aware Agent Resource Composition
items.titleZh: 代理需要什么？捆绑感知代理资源组合
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.22030v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: An agent resource's value depends on its backbone and companion resources and is known only after execution. Token-based generators remain tied to their training catalog, while independent resource scoring misses complementarities and reused bundles target other tasks. We formulate Task-Conditioned Agent Resource Composition (AgentComposition): jointly selecting a backbone model and a tool-skill bundle to maximize end-to-end execution utility. Our Retrieval-Grounded Bundle-Aware Agent Generation retrieves candidate resources and past configurations of similar tasks. A fine-tuned generator reads resource descriptions and recombines candidates through constrained beam search, allowing new resources without retraining. A bundle-aware critic ranks complete configurations using a large language model (LLM) teacher and historically successful configurations as execution proxies, and adapts to execution feedback when available. We evaluate reference recovery, offline execution with judged and native rewards, and online recommendation with real execution, building AgentSelect-Exec with 5,060 executed configurations. Our method recovers the complete reference configuration within ten candidates for 67.73% of AgentSelect queries, nearly twice the strongest baseline, and leads all baselines on SkillsBench. The proxy-trained critic raises the top-ranked agent's execution score from 7.58 to 8.37 out of 10; execution feedback increases it to 8.78, above the strongest baselines. Four target-domain queries suffice to adapt the generator to SkillsBench. Agents recommended online outperform the strongest baselines under both an LLM judge and native verifiers. These results support learning and transferring joint resource composition from task experience.

items.title: DeltaHarness: Self-Evolving Harnesses for Resource-Adaptive Tool Execution
items.titleZh: DeltaHarness：用于资源自适应工具执行的自我进化线束
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21688v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Tool-using agents rely on execution harnesses to organize and schedule tool operations. The same task and resource description can conceal runtime conditions that reverse the latency ordering of valid execution plans. Resolving this uncertainty requires firsthand execution in the target setting. We introduce DeltaHarness, an execution-guided policy-search method that adapts agent harnesses from cold-start measurements. Its QHI loop uses the observed response to update runtime dispatch, revise physical plans, and select experiments for later proposals. An independent confirmation panel controls policy replacement. With fixed dispatch, a revised materialization policy reduces complete-delivery latency by 30.0% on one video-editing task across three fresh pairs. On held-out tasks, the evolved policies reduce latency by 8.2% relative to the best fixed plan in one seed and by 4.6% relative to the initial proposal in another.

arXiv:2611.21688v1 公告类型：新

items.title: AdaFlowLite: Scalable and Non-blocking Inference on Asynchronous Mobile Data
items.titleZh: AdaFlowLite：异步移动数据的可扩展和非阻塞推理
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21691v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: The rise of mobile devices equipped with numerous sensors, such as LiDAR and cameras, has driven the adoption of multi-modal deep intelligence for distributed sensing tasks, such as smart cabins and driving assistance. However, the arrival time of mobile sensory data vary due to modality size and network dynamics, which can lead to delays (if waiting for slow data) or accuracy decline (if inference proceeds without waiting). Moreover, the diversity and dynamic nature of mobile systems exacerbate this challenge. In response, we present a shift to \textit{opportunistic} inference for asynchronous distributed multi-modal data, enabling inference as soon as partial data arrives. While existing methods focus on optimizing modality consistency and complementarity, known as modal affinity, they lack a \textit{computational} approach to control this affinity in open-world mobile environments. %
\sysname pioneers the formulation of structured cross-modality affinity in mobile contexts using a hierarchical analysis-based normalized matrix. This approach accommodates the diversity and dynamics of modalities, generalizing across different types and numbers of inputs. Employing an multi-modal lightweight Swin Transformer (MMLST), \sysname facilitates real-time and flexible data imputation, adapting to various modalities and downstream tasks without retraining. Experiments show that \sysname significantly reduces inference latency by up to 80.4\% and enhances accuracy by up to 62.1\%, while achieving nearly a 50\% reduction in energy consumption, outperforming status quo approaches. Also, this method can enhance LLM performance to preprocess asynchronous data.

arXiv:2611.21691v1 公告类型：新
摘要：配备大量传感器（例如激光雷达和摄像头）的移动设备的兴起推动了分布式传感任务（例如智能驾驶室和驾驶辅助）采用多模态深度智能。然而，移动传感数据的到达时间因模态大小和网络动态而变化，这可能导致延迟（如果等待慢速数据）或准确性下降（如果不等待而进行推理）。此外，移动系统的多样性和动态性加剧了这一挑战。作为回应，我们提出了对异步分布式多模态数据进行 \textit{机会主义} 推理的转变，以便在部分数据到达后立即进行推理。虽然现有方法侧重于优化模态一致性和互补性（称为模态亲和力），但它们缺乏 \textit{计算} 方法来控制开放世界移动环境中的这种亲和力。 %
\sysname 率先使用基于分层分析的归一化矩阵在移动环境中制定结构化跨模态亲和力。这种方法适应了模式的多样性和动态性，概括了不同类型和数量的输入。 \sysname 采用多模式轻量级 Swin Transformer (MMLST)，促进实时、灵活的数据插补，无需重新训练即可适应各种模式和下游任务。实验表明，\sysname 显着降低了推理延迟高达 80.4\%，将准确性提高了高达 62.1\%，同时实现了近 50\% 的能耗降低，优于现状方法。此外，该方法还可以增强 LLM 预处理异步数据的性能。

items.title: TIBECG: Temporal Information Bottleneck for Lead-Specific Demographic Privacy in ECG Waveform Release
items.titleZh: TIBECG：ECG 波形发布中特定导联人口统计隐私的时间信息瓶颈
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21694v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Transmitting an electrocardiogram (ECG) waveform can expose demographic information beyond an intended diagnostic task. We evaluate TIBECG, an architectural temporal information bottleneck, on individual leads extracted from hospital twelve-lead recordings. A 2,302,337-parameter processor varies its latent length while retaining the same nine-score consistency objective, without age or sex labels in protector fitting. Across 6,386 recordings, ten folds, 12 leads and 21 lengths, retrospective selections retained at least 95% of each lead's clean macro-F1. Their weaker age/sex interval gain exceeded the best eligible conventional transformation on all leads, by a median 22.08 percentage points. The implemented sampling-rate comparison shows that direct downsampling usually suppresses demographic inference more strongly but at a larger loss of diagnostic utility, whereas TIBECG favors utility preservation. Selection stability also varies by lead. Lower latent Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence does not reliably rank residual sex leakage at a fixed length. These findings support lead-specific evaluation of waveform processing, not validated consumer deployment or expert-readable reconstruction. When the waveform-input diagnostic classifier is hosted as part of a proprietary cloud service rather than deployed on the device, waveform transmission is required to obtain its scores.

摘要：传输心电图 (ECG) 波形可能会暴露超出预期诊断任务的人口统计信息。我们评估从医院 12 导联记录中提取的单个导联的 TIBECG（一种架构时间信息瓶颈）。一个 2,302,337 个参数的处理器改变其潜在长度，同时保留相同的九分一致性目标，保护器配件中没有年龄或性别标签。在 6,386 个录音、10 个折叠、12 个导联和 21 个长度中，回顾性选择保留了每个导联至少 95% 的干净宏 F1。他们较弱的年龄/性别间隔增益超过了所有线索上最符合条件的传统转换，中位数为 22.08 个百分点。实施的采样率比较表明，直接下采样通常会更强烈地抑制人口统计推断，但诊断效用损失更大，而 TIBECG 有利于效用保留。选择稳定性也因铅而异。较低的潜在 Kullback-Leibler (KL) 散度不能可靠地对固定长度的残余性别泄漏进行排序。这些发现支持波形处理的特定引线评估，而不是经过验证的消费者部署或专家可读的重建。当波形输入诊断分类器作为专有云服务的一部分托管而不是部署在设备上时，需要进行波形传输才能获得其分数。

items.title: Layerwise Learning-Rate Scaling in Vision Networks: Effective-Rate Identification, Power-Mean Aggregation, and Budget Dependence
items.titleZh: 视觉网络中的分层学习率缩放：有效率识别、幂均值聚合和预算依赖性
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21696v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Layerwise learning-rate scaling assigns different learning rates to different parts of a network. Although established in fine-tuning pretrained models, its effects in vision networks trained from scratch are commonly assessed by training each candidate recipe. We show that, in this setting, the rate-related component of a layerwise strategy is well summarized by an effective learning rate computable directly from its multiplier profile. Across matched-control comparisons, changes in test accuracy closely track changes in training loss (r = -0.996), which supports an optimization-progress explanation of the short-budget rate effect. Increasing the untuned base learning rate tenfold shifts the rate-matched contrast upward in all six tested architectures (p = 0.016) and increases the number of architectures in which a published discriminative schedule, excluded from model fitting, outperforms the uniform control from two to five of six (p = 0.031). Within the evaluated strategy space, a parameter-weighted power mean with exponent 0.35 (95% confidence interval [0.20, 0.50]) accounts for 42.6% of within-architecture variance, compared with 36.4% for the arithmetic mean. Ranking candidates by this scalar without training improves the selected candidate's mean percentile rank from the 26th to the 10th and reduces its mean accuracy shortfall relative to the best candidate from 3.70 to 1.12 points. The rate-related effect decays as the training budget increases; relative to tuned baselines, the overall strategy effect falls within the prespecified practical-equivalence margin in two of three architectures. A separate grouping-related contrast can persist at long budgets, although its direction and magnitude depend on the architecture.

items.title: FACE: Flow-Guided Angular Channel Estimation Framework for mmWave MIMO Systems
items.titleZh: FACE：毫米波 MIMO 系统的流引导角信道估计框架
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21698v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Acquiring accurate channel state information (CSI) is essential for millimeter-wave (mmWave) multi-input multi-output (MIMO) systems. However, it remains challenging due to high-dimensional channels, limited pilot observations, and measurement noise. To address these challenges, we propose flow-guided angular channel estimation (FACE), a novel channel estimation framework based on flow matching, an emerging generative modeling paradigm that learns continuous transport dynamics between probability distributions. FACE exploits the inherent angular-domain sparsity of mmWave channels and incorporates the learned flow matching model as a generative channel prior. Numerical results show that FACE consistently achieves higher channel estimation accuracy than both conventional estimators and diffusion-based generative estimator across diverse channel and system configurations. Moreover, FACE maintains high estimation accuracy with fewer pilot observations and achieves an average achievable rate close to the perfect-CSI benchmark. Compared with diffusion-based estimation, FACE requires substantially fewer sampling steps while achieving superior or comparable estimation accuracy, reducing inference time and computational cost. Overall, the proposed framework demonstrates the potential of flow matching for accurate, pilot-efficient, and computationally efficient mmWave MIMO channel estimation.

摘要：获取准确的信道状态信息（CSI）对于毫米波（mmWave）多输入多输出（MIMO）系统至关重要。然而，由于高维通道、有限的试点观测和测量噪声，它仍然具有挑战性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了流引导角信道估计（FACE），这是一种基于流匹配的新型信道估计框架，这是一种新兴的生成建模范例，可以学习概率分布之间的连续传输动态。 FACE 利用毫米波通道固有的角域稀疏性，并将学习到的流量匹配模型作为生成通道先验。数值结果表明，在不同的信道和系统配置中，FACE 始终比传统估计器和基于扩散的生成估计器实现更高的信道估计精度。此外，FACE 通过较少的试点观测保持了较高的估计精度，并实现了接近完美 CSI 基准的平均可实现率。与基于扩散的估计相比，FACE 需要更少的采样步骤，同时实现优异或相当的估计精度，从而减少推理时间和计算成本。总体而言，所提出的框架展示了流匹配在精确、导频高效和计算高效的毫米波 MIMO 信道估计方面的潜力。

items.title: Hybrid Quantum Selection of Learning Rates in Language-Model Training: Termination Criteria and an Interaction-Guided Schedule Oracle
items.titleZh: 语言模型训练中学习率的混合量子选择：终止标准和交互引导的调度预言机
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21701v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Learning-rate choices strongly affect language-model fine-tuning, but the best joint profile across layer groups is generally unknown. This paper studies quantum minimum finding for layer-group learning-rate selection within a hybrid classical-quantum training framework. It combines Durr-Hoyer minimum finding with BBHT search and compares fixed-budget and confidence-based stopping policies using a lookup oracle built from measured profile scores at fixed training checkpoints. The paper then introduces an Interaction-Guided Schedule Oracle that scores and marks joint schedules in superposition without a precomputed score table. Classical one-step loss measurements supply the main, pairwise and three-way interaction effects between layer groups. The circuit adds the effects for each schedule, compares the resulting score with the current baseline score, and marks improving schedules for amplitude amplification. Measured candidates are checked classically before acceptance. Uniform-rate training supplies the initial baseline; using schedules from classical adaptive methods as baselines for joint refinement is left for future work. In closed-loop fine-tuning of a 1.5-billion-parameter language model, each selected schedule drives the next 200 classical training steps. Benchmark accuracies lie within the range observed across five uniform-rate seeds. The results give a working example of how quantum superposition can support adaptive learning-rate selection during training; the remaining quantum limitations are discussed in the paper.

items.title: Margin Dynamics for Large Language Model Alignment
items.titleZh: 大型语言模型对齐的裕度动态
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21766v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Practitioners choose among LLM alignment methods largely by trial and error. We provide a theoretical foundation: each pairwise method defines a vector field on the probability simplex that governs how the model redistributes mass between preferred and dispreferred completions. Projecting onto a single preferred/dispreferred pair reduces this to a one-dimensional margin ODE with a closed-form solution. These solutions reveal that DPO margins grow without bound (logarithmically as $O(\log t)$ in the gradient-flow limit) while IPO margins converge to a finite $1/(2\tau)$; that label noise induces a qualitative phase transition in DPO (unbounded $\to$ bounded) but affects IPO only quantitatively; and that gradient concentration under asymmetric weighting governs trainability at scale. We confirm all three predictions across five model families spanning four benchmarks. The closed-form solutions also enable principled method design: we prove that adding any label smoothing $\varepsilon > 0$ to SimPO creates a finite margin attractor at $\Delta^* = \beta^{-1}\log((1-\varepsilon)/\varepsilon)$, while $\varepsilon = 0$ (standard SimPO) has no attractor. We test this across three models (8B-9B) and confirm the prediction: the theory-derived configuration (TPO-S, $\varepsilon = 0.05$) is competitive with the strongest baselines, attaining the highest mean IFEval score among the compared methods on all three, validating that the predicted finite attractor is a usable operating point rather than proposing a new state-of-the-art loss.

摘要：从业者主要通过反复试验来选择法学硕士对齐方法。我们提供了一个理论基础：每种成对方法都在概率单纯形上定义了一个向量场，该向量场控制模型如何在首选和不首选完成之间重新分配质量。投影到单个首选/非首选对上可将其简化为具有封闭形式解的一维边缘 ODE。这些解决方案表明，DPO 利润无限增长（在梯度流量限制中以对数形式表示为 $O(\log t)$），而 IPO 利润收敛于有限的 $1/(2\tau)$；标签噪声会引起 DPO 中的定性相变（无界 $\to$ 有界），但仅在数量上影响 IPO；不对称权重下的梯度浓度决定了大规模的可训练性。我们确认了跨越四个基准的五个模型系列的所有三个预测。封闭式解决方案还支持有原则的方法设计：我们证明，向 SimPO 添加任何平滑 $\varepsilon > 0$ 的标签会在 $\Delta^* = \beta^{-1}\log((1-\varepsilon)/\varepsilon)$ 处创建有限边缘吸引子，而 $\varepsilon = 0$（标准 SimPO）没有吸引子。我们在三个模型（8B-9B）上对此进行测试并确认预测：理论推导的配置（TPO-S，$\varepsilon = 0.05$）与最强的基线竞争，在所有三个模型的比较方法中获得最高的平均 IFEval 分数，验证预测的有限吸引子是一个可用的操作点，而不是提出新的最先进的损失。

items.title: Learning Calibrated and Samplable Predictive Distributions of Surface-Ocean $\Delta p$CO$_2$ Using Tabular Diffusion Models
items.titleZh: 使用表格扩散模型学习表面海洋 $\Delta p$CO$_2$ 的校准和可采样预测分布
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21769v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: The ocean absorbs almost 30% of anthropogenic CO$_2$ emissions, but quantifying this sink requires estimating surface-ocean CO$_2$ from observations that are sparse in space and time. Most existing machine-learning estimates of this field are deterministic, giving a single value per grid point, with uncertainty approximated post hoc via residuals, ensembles, or prescribed distributions. We instead learn a conditional predictive distribution for each observation: using Treeffuser, a conditional diffusion model with gradient-boosted-tree score functions, we estimate the full predictive distribution of $\Delta p$CO$_2$ (the sea-air $p$CO$_2$ difference) from 13 environmental, spatial, and temporal predictors. On a held-out SOCAT test set, Treeffuser attains the lowest continuous ranked probability score among the uncertainty-quantification methods evaluated (8.229 $\mu$atm) and the coverage closest to the nominal 68% / 95% levels (0.686 / 0.930), while retaining point-prediction skill comparable to a deterministic XGBoost baseline (RMSE 18.4 vs. 17.7 $\mu$atm; $R^2$ 0.77 vs. 0.79). These results show that conditional diffusion can provide well-calibrated, observation-level uncertainties while largely preserving point-prediction skill. Because Treeffuser is generative, its samples can support probabilistic analyses of $\Delta p$CO$_2$; extending this to spatially coherent field reconstruction will require modeling dependence across grid cells and evaluation on spatially held-out data.

items.title: Regularized Score Centering
items.titleZh: 正则化分数居中
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21791v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning increases training throughput, but data from stale policies and numerical mismatch between training and inference can destabilize learning. To stabilize off-policy learning, score centering (SC) removes the effect of reward baselines on the expected update. Our gradient diagnostics show less extreme gradients with SC than with importance sampling (IS), but SC can still fail when the learner moves far from the behavior policy that generated the data. To limit this policy mismatch, we introduce Regularized Score Centering (RSC), which adds a reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty to encourage the learner's next-token distribution to stay close to the behavior policy's next-token distribution. RSC works with or without truncated importance sampling (TIS), which caps token importance weights. Our theoretical analysis supports this approach, showing that KL regularization improves convergence guarantees. We evaluate dense and mixture-of-experts models on mathematical reasoning and agentic tasks, including online shopping, tool use, games, and fully asynchronous software engineering. RSC with TIS substantially improves sample efficiency across all agentic benchmarks, attaining higher training rewards with the same number of sampled responses. In final evaluations, it achieves top performance across all six agentic tasks, improving by 14.3% on AppWorld and reaching 9.9 times the strongest baseline's score on BabyAI.

arXiv:2611.21791v1 公告类型：新
摘要：异步强化学习提高了训练吞吐量，但来自过时策略的数据以及训练和推理之间的数值不匹配可能会破坏学习的稳定性。为了稳定离策略学习，分数中心化（SC）消除了奖励基线对预期更新的影响。我们的梯度诊断显示，SC 的极端梯度比重要性采样 (IS) 的梯度要小，但当学习者远离生成数据的行为策略时，SC 仍然会失败。为了限制这种策略不匹配，我们引入了正则化分数中心（RSC），它添加了反向 Kullback-Leibler（KL）惩罚，以鼓励学习者的下一个令牌分布保持接近行为策略的下一个令牌分布。 RSC 在使用或不使用截断重要性采样 (TIS) 的情况下均可工作，该采样限制了令牌重要性权重。我们的理论分析支持这种方法，表明 KL 正则化提高了收敛保证。我们评估数学推理和代理任务的密集和混合专家模型，包括在线购物、工具使用、游戏和完全异步软件工程。 RSC 与 TIS 显着提高了所有代理基准的样本效率，以相同数量的采样响应获得更高的训练奖励。在最终评估中，它在所有六项代理任务中都取得了最佳表现，在 AppWorld 上提高了 14.3%，在 BabyAI 上达到最强基线分数的 9.9 倍。

items.title: Urban Representation Learning for Identifying Potential Disparities in Crime Reporting
items.titleZh: 用于识别犯罪报告中潜在差异的城市表征学习
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21825v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Open crime data support urban safety analysis but reflect reported incidents rather than the complete distribution of criminal activity, potentially introducing spatial distortions in downstream analysis. We propose a self-supervised urban representation learning framework for identifying unusual reporting patterns relative to representation-similar peers using only georeferenced crime records. The method constructs complementary hourly, weekly, and static reporting profiles, learns scale-specific representations under geographic self-supervision, and integrates them into a unified latent space. Neighbor Profile Divergence (NPD) is then used to quantify disagreement between each region's reporting profile and those of its retrieved peers. Experiments on more than 1.8 million crime records from Mexico City, aggregated into 1,058 H3 regions, show that the proposed representation achieves a mean Silhouette score of 0.4052, compared with 0.2863 for Hex2Vec. NPD rankings remain highly stable across neighborhood sizes, with Spearman correlations from 0.9720 to 0.9951, while most high-divergence candidates persist across configurations. The retrieved peers also extend substantially beyond immediate geographic neighborhoods, indicating that the learned representation captures structure beyond local spatial proximity. High-divergence regions exhibit spatially organized patterns and, in several cases, differences in incident volume relative to peer expectations. These results support NPD as an internal auditing and prioritization mechanism for identifying regions that warrant further investigation, rather than as direct evidence of underreporting.

items.titleZh: VisHead-Spec：用于多模态推测解码的头部路由视觉注意

arXiv:2611.21839v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates vision-language models(VLMs) while preserving the target model's outputs, but its speedup diminishes under high concurrency serving as the system becomes more compute bounded as the batch size increases. This problem is pronounced for multimodal speculative decoding as the long range of the image tokens in the prompt can significantly increase the computational cost during draft token prediction. The block-diffusion drafters (e.g. DFlash, DSpark) can effectively speed up the draft model efficiency by predicting multiple draft tokens in one forward pass, but their speedup for VLMs under high concurrency is still modest (<9%). In order to understand this gap, we examine the information flow between different modalities from target model to draft model and identify the sparsity pattern of visual attention between the target and draft models: only small set of key-value heads in the draft model need direct visual feature attention in the context and only visual features from top level layers in the target model need to be attended in the context. We therefore propose VisHead-Spec, which selects a small, fixed set of key-value (KV) heads to attend to all image features from top level layers in the target model and restricts the remaining heads to text features. On Qwen3-VL-8B and MMSpec, VisHead-Spec-8 lets 8 of the drafter's 40 KV heads read the image while keeping accepted length within 0.3% of the block-diffusion draft model baseline (i.e. DSpark). At batch size 64, its throughput gain over autoregressive decoding increases to 16.0%, compared with 9.5% for DSpark; at batch size 1, its speedup remains comparable to DSpark.

arXiv:2611.21839v1 公告类型：新
摘要：推测性解码可以加速视觉语言模型（VLM），同时保留目标模型的输出，但在高并发情况下其加速会减弱，因为随着批量大小的增加，系统变得更加受计算限制。这个问题对于多模态推测解码来说很明显，因为提示中图像标记的长范围会显着增加草稿标记预测期间的计算成本。块扩散起草器（例如 DFlash、DSpark）可以通过在一次前向传递中预测多个草稿令牌来有效地加快草稿模型效率，但它们在高并发下对 VLM 的加速仍然不大（<9%）。为了理解这一差距，我们检查了从目标模型到草稿模型的不同模态之间的信息流，并确定了目标模型和草稿模型之间视觉注意力的稀疏模式：草稿模型中只有一小部分键值头需要上下文中的直接视觉特征关注，并且只有目标模型中顶层的视觉特征需要在上下文中关注。因此，我们提出 VisHead-Spec，它选择一小部分固定的键值 (KV) 头来处理目标模型中顶层的所有图像特征，并将剩余的头限制为文本特征。在 Qwen3-VL-8B 和 MMSpec 上，VisHead-Spec-8 让绘图员的 40 KV 头中的 8 个读取图像，同时将接受的长度保持在块扩散绘图模型基线（即 DSpark）的 0.3% 以内。在批量大小为 64 时，其相对于自回归解码的吞吐量增益增加到 16.0%，而 DSpark 为 9.5%；在批量大小为 1 时，其加速仍然与 DSpark 相当。

items.title: Inventa: Decentralized Self-Improving Agents for Autonomous Scientific Discovery
items.titleZh: Inventa：用于自主科学发现的去中心化自我改进代理
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21847v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can generate research ideas and improve scientific discovery through iterative experimentation. However, increasing the number of agents or iterations does not automatically translate to producing more diverse or feasible ideas. Agents may converge on similar candidates, propagate unsupported claims through shared memory components and repeatedly apply search strategies that no longer yield any improvements.
 We introduce Inventa, a framework for automated scientific discovery that employs autonomous research units and verified shared knowledge. Each unit creates a lineage of candidate ideas using a mutator agent. A local orchestrator agent periodically adapts the mutator's harness. When progress stalls, the orchestrator agent replaces its model or restarts the idea evolution process. Verifiers evaluate each candidate idea and record verified improvements, useful components and constraint violations in a shared knowledge, the only channel between units. We evaluate Inventa on five benchmarks spanning the research cycle, covering retrieval (ScholarCatalyst), ideation (IdeaBench), proposal writing (IdeaScientist), and scientific law discovery (EurekaBench, SciLaws-Bench). It leads all five, achieving 73.6% on EurekaBench versus 56.2% for CORAL. On IdeaBench, it discovers 26.0 novel ideas per paper, compared with 18.6 for ResearchAgent, with 82% fewer model calls.

items.title: When Does Discrete Ricci Curvature Help? An Edge-Level Analysis of Curvature-Enhanced GCNs for PPI Prediction
items.titleZh: 离散里奇曲率何时有用？用于 PPI 预测的曲率增强 GCN 的边缘级分析
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21849v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Curvature-enhanced graph convolutional networks (CGCN) incorporate Ollivier-Ricci curvature (ORC), grounded in optimal transport theory, into message passing, motivated by the claim that curvature-weighted edges alleviate "over-squashing" at structural bottlenecks. But does CGCN's improvement actually come from mitigating over-squashing? We investigate this on four real-world protein-protein interaction (PPI) datasets, comparing CGCN against a standard GCN at the level of individual edges rather than aggregate metrics alone. While CGCN improves aggregate AUC, AUPR, and F1 across all four datasets, this gain is concentrated almost entirely on low-degree edges, while performance on low-curvature (bottleneck) edges systematically degrades in three of four datasets, the opposite of what the over-squashing motivation predicts. Examining the learned edge-weight function directly, together with clustering-validity metrics, edge-distance ratios, and a layer-depth ablation across four depths, we find evidence for an alternative account: curvature-weighting sharpens the separation between clusters, which improves intra-cluster predictions at the cost of inter-cluster (bottleneck) ones. We test this account against topologically defined communities rather than the classification labels used elsewhere. Additionally, we offer practical guidance on when to prefer CGCN over standard GCN, depending on whether intra- or inter-cluster predictions matter most.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.21849v1 公告类型：新
摘要：曲率增强图卷积网络（CGCN）将基于最优传输理论的奥利维尔-里奇曲率（ORC）纳入消息传递，其动机是曲率加权边缘减轻了结构瓶颈处的“过度挤压”。但CGCN的进步真的来自于减轻过度挤压吗？我们在四个真实世界的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）数据集上对此进行了研究，在单个边缘水平上将 CGCN 与标准 GCN 进行比较，而不是单独聚合指标。虽然 CGCN 改善了所有四个数据集的聚合 AUC、AUPR 和 F1，但这种增益几乎完全集中在低度边缘上，而低曲率（瓶颈）边​​缘的性能在四个数据集中的三个数据集中系统性地下降，这与过度挤压动机的预测相反。直接检查学习到的边缘权重函数，以及聚类有效性指标、边缘距离比和四个深度的层深度消融，我们找到了另一种解释的证据：曲率加权锐化了簇之间的分离，从而以簇间（瓶颈）预测为代价改善了簇内预测。我们根据拓扑定义的社区而不是其他地方使用的分类标签来测试此帐户。此外，我们还提供了关于何时优先使用 CGCN 而不是标准 GCN 的实用指南，具体取决于集群内预测还是集群间预测最重要。

items.title: The Hidden Cost of MoE Diffusion Decoding: Profiling and Fixing the Sampler
items.titleZh: MoE 扩散解码的隐藏成本：分析和修复采样器
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21852v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) decode by iteratively denoising a full canvas of tokens, so every forward pass runs a per-token sampling and stopping pipeline over the entire canvas-by-vocabulary logits tensor. We profile single-user decoding of a 26B-parameter diffusion Mixture-of-Experts model on a bandwidth-bound edge accelerator (NVIDIA GB10) and report a result that is easy to miss: after weight quantisation, this logits pipeline, not the expert GEMMs, is the single largest consumer of decode time. Unlike autoregressive decoding, where sampling touches one position's logits per committed token, diffusion decoding processes S times as many logit entries per output token, where S is the number of denoising steps. We show this pipeline is largely redundant or fusable and remove it in two lossless tiers: a bit-exact tier whose output is byte-identical to the reference decoder, and an accuracy-parity tier using a fused single-pass entropy kernel and Gumbel-max sampling. Combined with a W4A16 expert kernel, the full stack reaches 2.4-2.7 times end-to-end speedup over bf16 at unchanged benchmark accuracy on GSM8K, HumanEval, and MATH, on a single 273 GB/s device. We confirm the finding on a second, independently built diffusion MoE (LLaDA2.0-mini: pipeline 28.8% of decode, fused W4A16 3.3 times at accuracy parity) and show it disappears on a dense diffusion model (3.6%). The cost is specific to MoE diffusion, where quantisation makes the backbone cheap. Code and quantised weights are released.

arXiv:2611.21852v1 公告类型：新
摘要：掩码扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 通过迭代地对整个标记画布进行去噪来进行解码，因此每次前向传递都会在整个画布上的词汇 logits 张量上运行每个标记采样和停止管道。我们在带宽限制边缘加速器 (NVIDIA GB10) 上对 26B 参数扩散专家混合模型的单用户解码进行了分析，并报告了一个很容易被忽略的结果：在权重量化之后，这个 Logits 管道（而不是专家 GEMM）是解码时间的最大消耗者。与自回归解码不同，自回归解码中采样涉及每个提交令牌的一个位置的 logit，扩散解码处理每个输出令牌的 S 倍 logit 条目，其中 S 是去噪步骤的数量。我们证明这个管道很大程度上是冗余的或可融合的，并在两个无损层中删除它：一个比特精确层，其输出与参考解码器的字节相同，以及一个使用融合单通道熵内核和 Gumbel-max 采样的精度奇偶校验层。与 W4A16 专家内核相结合，整个堆栈在单个 273 GB/s 设备上的 GSM8K、HumanEval 和 MATH 上的基准精度不变的情况下，端到端加速比 bf16 提高了 2.4-2.7 倍。我们在第二个独立构建的扩散 MoE 上证实了这一发现（LLaDA2.0-mini：解码的管道 28.8%，以准确度平价融合 W4A16 3.3 倍），并表明它在密集扩散模型上消失（3.6%）。成本特定于 MoE 扩散，其中量化使主干网变得便宜。代码和量化权重被发布。

items.title: tmol: a GPU-accelerated implementation of the Rosetta energy function for machine learning
items.titleZh: tmol：用于机器学习的 Rosetta 能量函数的 GPU 加速实现
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.21857v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Physics-inspired forcefields complement generative machine learning models, showing better generalization beyond the training distribution. However, these forcefields are typically slow to evaluate, and their derivatives are difficult to integrate into ML frameworks. We introduce tmol, a GPU-native PyTorch library implementing the state-of-the-art RosettaGenFF forcefield. tmol supports efficient batched differentiable scoring and whole-structure refinement with up to 362-fold throughput increase (batched). Used as a reward in generative protein design, tmol increases hydrogen bonds and water bridges at designed interfaces.

摘要：受物理启发的力场补充了生成机器学习模型，显示出训练分布之外更好的泛化能力。然而，这些力场的评估通常很慢，并且它们的衍生物很难集成到机器学习框架中。我们引入 tmol，这是一个 GPU 原生 PyTorch 库，实现了最先进的 RosettaGenFF 力场。 tmol 支持高效的批量可微分评分和整体结构细化，吞吐量增加高达 362 倍（批量）。 tmol 用作生成蛋白质设计中的奖励，可增加设计界面处的氢键和水桥。
